tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Arlo Copperwisp's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Request and gather all estate‑planning documents for Arlo Copperwisp, including trust‑funding evidence and updated fiduciary role information, by March 22, 2024.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
